rv: This is a thoroughly enjoyable film with a good story, well acted by Mickey Rooney but a little disappointing for Peter Lorre who doesn't really shine. They all seem a little naive by today's standards but even so its well worth watching. I did wonder as the film was playing if it had been filmed in the Santa Monica area and sure enough much to my delight, the end scenes are on Santa Monica Pier. As I'd visited Santa Monica last year from England, I then spent several minutes seeing if I could recognise any of the parts of the Pier, and sure enough I could.
Mickey Rooney does an excellent job in a type of role that I don't typically associate with him. Bravo.

Plenty of suspense, plenty of humanity. There's one subtle blooper 4 minutes from the end. The lawyer's car is a 1950 or so Packard, but when he tunes in the radio, we see the dashboard of a 1948 Dodge. And he's turning the map light, not the radio tuning knob.
